name: Kommo
description: Let your AI work in Kommo CRM: find and update leads across pipelines, look up contacts and companies, follow tasks and notes, and log new tasks and notes. One account, with a long-lived token from a private integration.
instructions:
## Kommo
This connector works with one Kommo CRM account through the **API v4** (`https://<subdomain>.kommo.com/api/v4`): leads with pipelines and stages, contacts, companies, custom fields, tasks, notes and users. It can create and update leads, create contacts and tasks, and add notes. It authenticates with a **long-lived token** of a private integration in your own account.

**Setup (account administrator, about 3 minutes)**
1. In Kommo open **Settings → Integrations** and click **Create integration** (top right). Choose a private integration, leave **Redirect URL** empty, keep the access scopes you need and **Save**.
2. Open the integration's **Keys and scopes** tab and click **Generate long-lived token**. Pick an expiry date and copy the token right away: Kommo shows it only once.
3. Paste it into `KOMMO_ACCESS_TOKEN`, and your account's subdomain into `KOMMO_SUBDOMAIN`: for `https://acme.kommo.com` enter `acme`.
4. The token acts as the administrator who created it. Revoke it on the integration's **Authorization** tab; when it expires, generate a new one.

**Read-only setup**: Kommo tokens cannot be limited to reading, so switch off `kommo_create_lead`, `kommo_update_lead`, `kommo_create_contact`, `kommo_create_task` and `kommo_add_note`. Nothing in this connector deletes data.

**Ids and values**: every id is an integer. Lead stages are `status_id` values inside a `pipeline_id` from `kommo_list_pipelines`; 142 is Closed-won and 143 Closed-lost in every pipeline. Responsible users come from `kommo_list_users`. Phone, email and all other extra data live in `custom_fields_values`: `[{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "..."}]}]`, select options by `enum_id`, contact phone and email by `field_code` PHONE or EMAIL with `enum_code` such as WORK; `kommo_list_custom_fields` lists ids and options. Dates are Unix timestamps in seconds. Linked entities are in `_embedded`; add `with=contacts` (leads) or `with=leads` (contacts) to get them.

**Pagination**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `limit` (up to 250). The response's `_links.next` shows that more exists; an empty answer (HTTP 204, no body) means there are no results or no more pages.

**Rate limits**: at most 7 requests per second per account. Over it Kommo answers 429; repeated violations block the IP address with 403 for every call. Avoid paging through all leads when a filter or search does the job.

**Errors**: 401 means the token is wrong, expired or revoked: generate a new one. 402 means the account's subscription has lapsed. 403 can mean the token's user lacks rights or the IP was blocked after too many requests. 404 is a wrong id or subdomain. 400 lists the invalid fields under `validation-errors`, for example a stage that does not belong to the pipeline or a custom field value of the wrong type.

**Out of scope here**: deleting entities, unsorted (incoming) leads, chats and messages, lists (catalogs), webhooks and Salesbot.

KOMMO_SUBDOMAIN.label: Kommo subdomain
KOMMO_SUBDOMAIN.help: The first part of your account address: acme for https://acme.kommo.com. A pasted full address is shortened to it.

KOMMO_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Long-lived token
KOMMO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Kommo → Settings → Integrations → your private integration → Keys and scopes → Generate long-lived token. It is shown only once.
KOMMO_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Kommo refused the token. It may be wrong, expired or revoked: generate a new long-lived token under Settings → Integrations → your integration → Keys and scopes.
verifyHints.402: Kommo reports that the account's subscription has expired. Renew it in Kommo, then try again.
verifyHints.403: Kommo denied access: the token's user lacks rights, or the IP address was blocked after too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
verifyHints.404: No Kommo account answers at this subdomain. Use the first part of your address, e.g. acme for https://acme.kommo.com.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Kommo allows 7 requests per second. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: A Kommo account (a trial works) and an account administrator, who creates a private integration and generates its long-lived token (about 3 minutes).

tools.name: kommo_get_account
tools.description: Get the Kommo account: id, name, subdomain, current user id, country, currency, language, and with the default extras its task types (ids for tasks) and date and time settings.

with.description: Comma-separated extras: task_types, users_groups, datetime_settings, version, entity_names (default task_types,datetime_settings).

tools.name: kommo_list_leads
tools.description: List or search leads (deals): id, name, price, pipeline and stage (status_id), responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields and, with with=contacts, linked contacts. Free-text query, filters by pipeline, stage, responsible user and dates, sorting. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against the lead's filled fields (name, custom fields, linked contact data).

status_pipeline_id.description: With status_id: the pipeline of that stage. Filters one stage of one pipeline.

status_id.description: With status_pipeline_id: only leads in this stage.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

created_from.description: Created at or after this Unix time (seconds).

created_to.description: Created at or before this Unix time (seconds).

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

updated_to.description: Updated at or before this Unix time (seconds).

closed_from.description: Closed at or after this Unix time (seconds).

closed_to.description: Closed at or before this Unix time (seconds).

with.description: Comma-separated extras: contacts, loss_reason, source, catalog_elements.

tools.name: kommo_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id with its name, price, pipeline, stage, responsible user, dates, tags, custom field values, linked company and, by default, linked contacts.

with.description: Comma-separated extras: contacts, loss_reason, source, catalog_elements (default contacts).

tools.name: kommo_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead, optionally in a given pipeline and stage, with price, responsible user, custom fields, tags and links to existing contacts and a company. Returns the new lead id. Show the user what will be created and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful create.

price.description: Sale value in the account currency.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline id from kommo_list_pipelines (default: main pipeline).

status_id.description: Stage id in that pipeline (default: its first stage).

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id from kommo_list_users (default: the token's user).

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from kommo_list_custom_fields.

company_ids.description: Company to link, e.g. [{"id": 456}] (a lead has at most one).

tools.name: kommo_update_lead
tools.description: Change a lead: name, price, stage or pipeline (moving it through the funnel; Closed-won is status 142, Closed-lost 143), responsible user, loss reason, custom fields or tags. Only the given fields change. Confirm with the user before writing.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline id; send with status_id when moving to another pipeline.

status_id.description: Stage id from kommo_list_pipelines; 142 closes as won, 143 as lost.

loss_reason_id.description: Loss reason id, when closing as lost.

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from kommo_list_custom_fields.

tools.name: kommo_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts: id, name, first and last name, responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields (phone and email are custom fields) and, with with=leads, linked leads. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against names and custom field values such as phone or email.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

updated_to.description: Updated at or before this Unix time (seconds).

tools.name: kommo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id with names, responsible user, tags, custom field values (phones, emails, position), linked companies and, by default, linked leads.

tools.name: kommo_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact with name, responsible user, phone, email and other custom fields, and tags. Returns the new contact id; link it to a lead with kommo_create_lead or in Kommo. Confirm with the user before writing; Kommo does not check for duplicates here, so search first.

name.description: Full name (or set first_name and last_name).

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the token's user).

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from kommo_list_custom_fields.

tools.name: kommo_list_companies
tools.description: List or search companies: id, name, responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields and, with with=leads,contacts, linked leads and contacts. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against the name and custom field values.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

tools.name: kommo_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the lead pipelines with their stages: pipeline id, name, whether main or archived, and per stage (in _embedded.statuses) its id, name, sort order, color and type. Every pipeline also has the system stages 142 (Closed-won) and 143 (Closed-lost).

tools.name: kommo_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of leads, contacts or companies: id, name, code (PHONE, EMAIL for contacts), type and, for select fields, the enum options with their ids. Use them to read and write custom_fields_values.

tools.name: kommo_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks: id, text, type, deadline (complete_till), whether completed, result, responsible user and the lead, contact or company it belongs to. Filter by responsible user, state, type or entity. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

is_completed.description: 1 for completed tasks, 0 for open ones.

task_type_ids.description: Only these task types (1 follow-up, 2 meeting, others from kommo_get_account).

entity_type.description: Only tasks of this entity type (needed with entity_ids).

tools.name: kommo_create_task
tools.description: Create a task with a deadline, linked to a lead, contact or company, for a responsible user. Returns the new task id. Confirm with the user before writing.

complete_till.description: Deadline as Unix time in seconds.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity the task belongs to.

task_type_id.description: Task type: 1 follow-up (default), 2 meeting, or a custom type id from kommo_get_account.

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the token's user).

tools.name: kommo_list_notes
tools.description: Read the notes (timeline entries) of one lead, contact or company: id, type (common text note, call_in, call_out, sms, service messages, ...), params with the text or call data, author and dates. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

tools.name: kommo_add_note
tools.description: Add a text note to the timeline of a lead, contact or company. Returns the new note id. Confirm the text with the user before writing.

tools.name: kommo_list_users
tools.description: List the account's users: id, name, email, language and rights, and with with=role,group their role and group. User ids are what responsible_user_id fields hold. Up to 250 per page.
